detailed_families.title: MANASLU PRX-8000
details: Sensor / platform: Triple Sensor | Water resistance: 100 m / 10 bar | Power: Tough Solar | Synchronization: Multi Band 6

All size values are family references unless an explicit model-specific footnote says otherwise. PRW-3500T thickness 14.8 mm stays separate from the generic 14.5 mm family reference.
PRW-3000 has no dimensions in this source; PRW-3100 dimensions are not substituted. PRG-240 dimensions are not given.

SPF-100-1V / 2173 and SPF-100S-1V / 2172 are uncertain graphic associations. No fitted module, module candidates or numeric module profiles are created from them.
SPF battery, dimensions and mass are graphic-only, unverified values. The archive-derived page identifies the J/SJ models, not the graphic-only labels.
Catalog/source page numbers are PDF page positions, not necessarily printed page numbers. Catalog or compilation dates are not individual model release dates.
No source scans, photographs, artwork or comparison graphic are published. All supplied facts remain pending independent review.
